pages.title: How to import links from a CSV file
pages.description: Easily import your links from a CSV file into RevRoute.
pages.body:
You can also import your existing links into RevRoute via our CSV import feature. This is useful if you have a large list of links to import or if you want to import links from another provider that we don't have a 1-click importer for.

To import your links, you can follow these steps:

**Prepare your CSV file**

Before you import your CSV file, make sure it is in the correct format. Your CSV file needs to have the following data:

| RevRoute field  | Required | Description                                                    | Example                   |
| --------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| Destination URL | **Yes**  | The destination URL of the link you want to import.            | `https://www.google​.com` |
| Short link      | **Yes**  | The shortened version of the link.                             | `yourdomain.com/abc123`   |
| Title           | No       | The title of the link.                                         | `Google`                  |
| Description     | No       | The description of the link.                                   | `Search the web`          |
| Tags            | No       | The tags of the link – must be a comma-separated list of tags. | `search, google, web`     |
| Creation date   | No       | The date the link was created.                                 | `2024-01-01`              |

The actual names of your columns can be anything you want, but you need to make sure that the required columns are present.

**Upload your CSV file**

If you haven't already, create a workspace on RevRoute.

**Справка.**

  **Protip**: Once you create your workspace, we generally recommend that you **_not
  configure your domain_** until
  you've migrated all your links. This will prevent any potential downtime for
  your links.

Then, on the Links page, click the **⋮** button to the right of the search box and select **Import from CSV**.

This will open a modal with a file uploader.

Upload your CSV file, and you should be automatically redirected to the next step.

**Review the AI-generated column mappings**

When you upload a CSV file, RevRoute uses AI to map the columns in your file to the supported data fields in RevRoute: CSV columns on the left, RevRoute fields on the right. Required fields are marked with an asterisk.

You can then review and edit the mappings before selecting **Confirm import**. In just a few seconds, all your links will be migrated to RevRoute.

Alternatively, you can also select **Choose another file** to upload a different CSV file.

**Review the import summary**

Once all your links have been imported, we will send you an email to let you know that the import is complete. If there are any issues with some of the links, we will send you a separate email with the details of the errors.

**Configure your domain**

Once all your links are imported, you can configure your domain by setting the right DNS records. Once this is done, you can start using your links!

pages.body:
Bitly is a popular URL shortener that lets you create short links, which can be used in your marketing campaigns, social media posts, and more.

## How to migrate from Bitly to RevRoute

If you're looking to migrate from Bitly to RevRoute, we've built a custom migration tool that will help you migrate your links in just 2-3 clicks.

**Sign in with Bitly**

If you haven't already, create a workspace on RevRoute.

**Справка.**

  **Protip**: Once you create your workspace, we generally recommend that you **_not
  configure your domain_** until
  you've migrated all your links. This will prevent any potential downtime for
  your links.

Then, open the import dialog with this direct link: app.revroute.ru/links?import=bitly. For now, the **⋮** menu on the Links page only offers CSV import. In the dialog, click **Sign in with Bitly**.

On the sign-in screen, click "Allow" and you'll be redirected back to RevRoute.

Behind the scenes, we'll fetch all your Bitly groups and their respective custom domains and number of tags. You'll be presented with a list of groups that we've found.

**Справка.**

  If you accidentally signed in to the wrong Bitly account, you can click on the
  **Sign in with a different account?** link to sign in with a different Bitly
  account.

**Select the domains you want to migrate**

Once all your links have been imported, we will send you an email to let you know that the migration is complete.

**Configure your domain**

Once you receive the email, you can configure your domain by setting the right DNS records. This will ensure that your links are pointing to RevRoute and not Bitly. Once you've done this, you can start using your links!

**Совет.**

  If the import doesn't start, export your links from Bitly to a CSV file and

pages.title: How to change my default workspace on RevRoute?

On RevRoute, you can set a workspace as your default workspace. This is the workspace that opens when you log in to RevRoute.

pages.title: How to delete my RevRoute account?
pages.description: Learn how to delete your account on RevRoute

headings.text: When I delete my account, do you remove all my data?

pages.body:
First of all, if you're reading this article and are looking to delete your RevRoute account, we're sorry to see you go!

We would appreciate any feedback on how we could improve our platform – feel free to send us an email!

You can delete your RevRoute account by following the steps below:

1. Open your account settings: click your avatar in the bottom-left corner and select **Account settings**.
2. Scroll down to the **Delete account** section.
3. Click the **Delete account** button and type `confirm delete account` in the input field to confirm.
4. After confirming, your account will be permanently deleted. Please note that this action is irreversible.

**Совет.**

  **You cannot delete your account if you're an owner of a workspace.** You can
  either delete the workspace or transfer ownership to another user before
  deleting your account.

## How to delete my workspace?

You can delete your workspace by following the steps below:

1. Open your workspace settings: **Settings** → **General**.
2. Scroll down to the **Delete workspace** section and click the button of the same name.
3. To confirm, enter your workspace slug and the phrase `confirm delete workspace`.

The workspace's custom domains, all of its links, and their analytics are permanently deleted along with it.

**Совет.**

  You can also open your workspace settings by inserting your workspace slug
  into this link: `https://app.revroute.ru/<slug>/settings`.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please contact our support team.

We hope to see you back someday!

## When I delete my account, do you remove all my data?

Yes, when you delete your RevRoute account, all data associated with it will be permanently removed from our systems. Workspaces you own need to be deleted or transferred to another user beforehand — see the section above.

Your email address will also be removed from our mailing list, and you will no longer receive any emails from RevRoute.

pages.title: How to cancel my RevRoute subscription?
pages.description: Learn how to cancel your RevRoute subscription, or downgrade to a lower plan if needed.

headings.text: How can I cancel my RevRoute subscription?
How can I change my RevRoute plan?

pages.body:
First of all, if you are planning to cancel your subscription, we're really sorry to see you go! We would appreciate any feedback on how we could improve our platform – feel free to send us an email!

## How can I cancel my RevRoute subscription?

Subscriptions are set up separately for each workspace. To cancel yours:

1. In your workspace, open **Settings** → **Billing**.
2. Click the **⋮** button next to **View invoices** and select **Cancel subscription**.
3. If a confirmation dialog appears, confirm the cancellation. The cancellation may also take effect right away — RevRoute then shows a “Subscription canceled” notice.

After you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the paid period — a banner with the end date appears on the **Billing** page. If the paid period has already ended, the plan is switched off within an hour. After that, the workspace moves to the Free plan. If you change your mind, select **Resume subscription** in the same menu.

We really hope to see you back someday!

## How can I change my RevRoute plan?

To switch to another plan, including a lower one:

1. In your workspace, open **Settings** → **Billing**.
2. Click **Manage plan** — on the free plan, the button is called **Upgrade**.
3. Choose a plan and a billing period — monthly or yearly.

Enterprise plans don't have a plan change button: Enterprise terms are negotiated individually, so contact us to change them.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please contact our support team.

pages.title: How to change my RevRoute billing information?
pages.description: Learn how to change your billing card and update your subscription details on RevRoute.

headings.text: Updating your billing email and company details

pages.body:
First of all, thank you for upgrading to a paid plan on RevRoute!

Your support helps us keep building and improving RevRoute. This guide walks you through updating the card we charge for your subscription.

## How billing works on RevRoute

RevRoute processes subscription payments through the platform's built-in payment infrastructure. The first time you subscribe, you save a card through a secure payment widget — the card is tokenized and linked to your workspace. All subsequent renewals charge that token automatically.

This means:

- Your card details are not stored by RevRoute — only the payment token.
- You can replace the saved card at any time from your billing settings.
- The card on file is shown in a masked format (`Visa •••• 4242`).

## Replacing your saved card

**Open billing settings**

From your workspace dashboard (e.g. `app.revroute.ru/<your-workspace>`), click **Settings → Billing**.

You'll see the active subscription, the next renewal date, and the card currently on file.

**Click Replace card**

Under **Payment method**, click **Replace card**.

This opens the payment widget. You'll be asked to enter your new card details. A small authorization (1 ₽ or similar) verifies the card and is refunded immediately.

**Confirm**

Once the new card is verified, the previous token is discarded and all future renewals charge the new card.

**Совет.**

  If your card expires or your bank reissues it with a new PAN, please replace
  it before the next renewal date — otherwise the renewal will fail and your
  workspace may be downgraded to the free plan.

## Updating your billing email and company details

The card is one thing; the legal entity that owns the subscription is another. To update the **company name, INN, KPP, or billing email** that appears on your closing documents:

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoice details**.
2. Update your company name, INN, KPP and billing email.
3. Save — your next invoice will reflect the new details.

**Примечание.**

  Changes to billing details are applied to **future** invoices only. For
  corrections to invoices that have already been issued, reach out to
  support@revroute.ru.

## Downloading invoices

Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices** for a list of all subscription receipts. Each invoice includes the payment transaction ID for your accounting team.

## Cancelling your subscription

You can cancel any time from **Settings → Billing → Manage subscription**. You'll keep access to paid features until the end of the current billing period; no further charges will be made to your card after cancellation.

pages.title: Configuring SCIM Directory Sync with Azure AD
pages.description: For RevRoute Enterprise users, you can automatically provision and deprovision users from Azure AD to RevRoute using SCIM Directory Sync.

headings.text: Step 1: Configure Directory Sync on RevRoute
Step 2: Add Provisioning to SAML Application

pages.body:
**Совет.**

  This feature is only available on RevRoute Enterprise.

For RevRoute Enterprise users, you can automatically provision and deprovision users from your Azure Active Directory (AD) to RevRoute using SCIM Directory Sync.

**Create a SAML application in Azure**

    Before you can configure SCIM Directory Sync, you need to create a SAML
    application in Azure.

## Step 1: Configure Directory Sync on RevRoute

In your RevRoute workspace, open **Settings** → **Security**.

In the **Directory Sync** block, click **Configure** next to **SCIM**. This opens the **Configure Directory Sync** dialog:

1. Select **Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)** as the **Directory Provider**.
2. Click **Save changes**.

This will generate a Directory Sync connection for your RevRoute workspace, and return 2 values, which will be needed in Step 2:

1. **Tenant URL**
2. **Secret Token**

## Step 2: Add Provisioning to SAML Application

Click on the **Provisioning** tab of your existing RevRoute SAML application in Azure that you want to enable SCIM provisioning for.

In the Provisioning tab, click on **Get started**.

Select **Automatic** from the **Provisioning Mode** dropdown. Under the **Admin Credentials** section, enter the values that you obtained from Step 1:

1. **Tenant URL**
2. **Secret Token**

Click on **Test Connection** to test the connection to see if the credentials are correct, then click **Save** to save the credentials.

Expand the **Mappings** section and ensure group and user attribute mappings are enabled for your app. The default mapping should work.

Expand the **Settings** section and make the following changes:

- Select **Sync only assigned users and groups** from the **Scope** dropdown.
- Confirm the **Provisioning Status** is set to **On**.

Click **Save** to save the changes.

Congratulations! You've successfully configured SCIM provisioning for your RevRoute workspace.

## Step 3: Assign Users

Once you've configured Directory sync, you can assign users to RevRoute directly within Azure AD.

From your application, click the **Users and groups** from the left navigation menu and click **Add user/group**.

Click on **None Selected** under **Users**.

From the right side of the screen, select the users you want to assign to the app and click the **Select** button. Thenm click **Assign** to those users to your app.

Your assigned users should now receive an invitation email to join your RevRoute workspace.

**Внимание.**

  Azure AD SCIM provisioning can take anywhere between 20-40 minutes to
  sync.
  This means that it may take up to 40 minutes for your users to receive the
  invitation email and be able to join your RevRoute workspace.

They will also be able to sign in to RevRoute using Azure AD SSO

pages.title: What is a "Workspace" on RevRoute?
pages.description: Learn more about what a "Workspace" is on RevRoute and how you can use it to organize your links.

headings.text: How many domains can I add to a workspace?

pages.body:
On RevRoute, a "Workspace" is a space that holds the short links, domains, analytics, and partner program for your website, app, or business.

You can think of a RevRoute workspace as a "Team" or an "Organization" where you can invite your teammates to work together.

To switch between workspaces or create a new one, open the workspace menu by clicking the workspace logo in the top-left corner. The menu also has **Settings** and **Invite members** buttons.

## How to create a workspace

Open the workspace menu and click **Create workspace**.

Here are the fields in the workspace creation dialog:

1. **Workspace name**: the name of your company or product.
2. **Workspace slug**: your workspace's unique identifier in the `app.revroute.ru/<slug>` address. It's also used in your partner program's address.
3. **Workspace logo**: optional; the recommended size is 160×160 px.

Once you have filled in the fields, click **Create workspace**.

## Onboarding checklist

In the bottom-right corner of your workspace, the **Complete setup** button opens a checklist of first steps:

1. **Connect a domain** — a custom domain for your short links.
2. **Create a program** — your partner program.
3. **Set up conversion tracking** — to see leads and sales, not just clicks (developer guide).
4. **Invite partners** — invitations to your program.

Completed steps are checked off. The **Hide tips** button hides the checklist.

## How many domains can I add to a workspace?

Custom domains are available on every plan, including the free RevRoute Links Free plan. The number of domains you can connect depends on your plan:

- **RevRoute Links**: Free — 1 domain, Pro — 10, Business — 50;
- **RevRoute Partners**: Business — 100 domains, Advanced — 250;
- **Enterprise** plans of both product lines — by custom agreement.

See the pricing page for current terms.

If your workspace has multiple domains, you can filter links by domain: **Filter** → **Domain**.

## Billing for workspaces

On RevRoute, you can create several workspaces, and each one is billed separately. A workspace's plan and billing cycle are shown in **Settings** → **Billing**. To learn how to change your plan or cancel your subscription, see this article.

pages.title: Managing workspace members with roles
pages.description: Learn how to use roles to manage your workspace members' permissions on RevRoute.
pages.body:
On RevRoute, you can invite your teammates to join your workspace. This is useful if you want to collaborate with your team on your short links.

When you invite your teammates, it is important to understand that you can manage their permissions and roles in your workspace. This is where roles come in.

There are four roles you can assign to your team members:

## Owner role

The owner of a workspace has the highest level of access. When you create a new workspace, you are automatically assigned the owner role by default. Then, when you invite your teammates, you can assign them either the owner or member role.

## Member role

When you invite your teammates to join your workspace, they are assigned the member role by default.

The member role is limited in what they can do compared to the owner role – this can be useful for security purposes, e.g. you may want to give your team members the ability to manage short links and tags, but not the ability to manage domains or the workspace settings.

## Viewer role

The viewer role is meant for teammates who need visibility into what is happening in the workspace, without the ability to make changes. This is a good fit for stakeholders, clients, or teammates who want to review links, performance, and partner activity, but should not be able to edit, create, or delete anything.

**Совет.**

  The Viewer role is only available on Business plans and
  above.

## Billing role

The billing role is intended for teammates who are responsible for partner payouts and managing billing information. This role gives them access to billing details (e.g. topping up the partner payout balance) and payout actions, while keeping the rest of the workspace locked down.

**Совет.**

  The Billing role is only available on Advanced plans and
  above.

## Comparison grid

pages.title: Several managers in one partner account
pages.description: How to invite managers to your RevRoute partner account, give each of them their own link and track clicks, leads and sales per manager.

headings.text: Create a link for each manager
8. Short link with the manager's name
11. Clicks, leads and sales per link

pages.body:
Managers don't need to sign up separately or join the program again. You keep one partner account, invite your managers to it and create a link for each of them. Clicks, leads and sales are counted per link, so you can see what each manager brought in.

> Screenshots show the Russian interface; button names are given in both languages.

## Invite your managers

### 1. Profile icon

In the left panel of the partner dashboard, click the profile icon.

### 2. Members

In the profile menu, open **Members** («Участники»).

### 3. Invite member

Click **Invite member** («Пригласить участника») in the top right corner, or press `M`.

### 4. Email and role

Enter the manager's email and keep the **Member** («Участник») role. **Add email** adds another row, so you can invite several people at once.

### 5. Send the invite

Click **Send invite** («Отправить приглашение»). The manager receives an email with a link; the invite is valid for 14 days.

> The **Member** role works with programs and links but can't manage the team or payout details — that stays with the owner. More on roles in Inviting your partner team.

## Create a link for each manager

### 6. Open the program's links

Go to the program and open **Links** («Ссылки») in the left menu.

### 7. Create link

Click **Create link** («Создать ссылку»), or press `C`.

### 8. Short link with the manager's name

In **Short link** («Короткая ссылка»), enter a clear name such as `your-company-anna`. You can leave **Destination URL** empty — the link will lead to the program's website.

### 9. Comment

In **Comments** («Комментарии»), note whose link it is: "Anna Smith, manager". Comments are visible to everyone in the account.

### 10. Create the link

Click **Create link** and hand it to the manager. Repeat steps 7–10 for each manager.

> If **Create link** is disabled, your group has reached the program's link limit or the program doesn't let partners create their own links. Contact the program's support.

## See results per manager

### 11. Clicks, leads and sales per link

The **Links** page shows clicks, leads and sales for every link. The icon next to the period switches the view: the compact list shows all-time totals, cards show charts for the selected period. Click a link to open analytics for that link only.

## Good to know

- **Rewards go to the partner account as a whole**, not to a specific manager. Links show who brought what; splitting the rewards inside your company is up to you.
- **Everyone in the account sees all links.** A link is tied to a manager only by its name and comment.
- **If a manager needs separate commissions and payouts**, they need their own partner account with their own program enrollment.

pages.title: Inviting your partner team
pages.description: Learn how to invite team members, assign roles, and manage access to your partner profile on RevRoute.
pages.body:
On RevRoute, Partner teams let you share access to your RevRoute partner profile with the people you work with. This is useful for creators, agencies, or anyone who wants more than one person managing partner activity.

## Where to manage your team

To manage your partner team, select the **Partner profile** icon in the left sidebar, then navigate to the **Members** tab.

This view lists everyone with access, including their email and assigned role.

## Roles and permissions

Partner team members support two role types: owner and member.

### Owner

The Owner has full control of the partner account. This includes:

- Updating partner profile settings
- Managing team members (inviting and removing members)
- Managing payout details

### Member

Members have standard access. They can view and manage partner activity across all programs, but cannot manage team members or payout details.

## Inviting a new member

To invite a new member to your partner team, click the **Invite member** button in the top right.

Enter the member's email address, and select their role. You can invite more than one member at a time, and they'll each receive their own invite email to accept membership.

**Справка.**
You can only invite up to 10 teammates per partner team.

## Changing a role

Only Owner-roled members in a partner team can change another member’s role. To change a member's role, click the role dropdown in the members table and select a new role.

This will open the confirmation modal, where you can confirm the update:

## Removing a member

To remove a member from your team, click the `⋯` dropdown and select **Remove member**.

This deletes the team member, and the person can no longer sign in to your partner profile.

pages.title: Merging your partner accounts
pages.description: Learn how to merge one of your partner accounts with another, to keep things organized and better managed.

headings.text: Where to find the merge option

pages.body:
**Внимание.**

Merging your accounts is a permanent action and cannot be undone once it's complete.

## Reasons to merge accounts
There are some reasons why you want to merge your partner accounts on RevRoute:
- **Consolidate accounts:** You were enrolled in 2 affiliate programs on RevRoute under different emails.
- **Simplify management**: You want to be able to manage your payouts, programs, and reporting all from one place.
## What merges?
All of the following merge with this action:
- Enrolled programs
- Referral links
- Analytics (clicks, leads, and sales data)
- Commissions
- Payouts
## What doesn't merge?
- Profile info
- Website and social accounts
- Connected payout methods
- Duplicate bounty submissions (the ones on the source account will be deleted)
## Where to find the merge option
On your **Partner profile** page, open the **⋮** menu in the top right and select **Merge accounts**.

Clicking this will open a dialog window that has 3 steps to merging your account.
## Steps to merge

**Confirm account email addresses**

Enter the email addresses of the accounts you'd like to merge. You'll need to have access to both email accounts to verify them.

There are two fields to complete:

- **Source account** - the email address of the account you want to merge into the `target account`
- **Target account** - the email address of the account you want the `source account` to merge into

Once these have been added, click **Send codes** to continue the verification process.

**Verify the email addresses**

We'll send an email to each address with a OTP (one-time password) that will be input on this step.

The emails will look like this:

Enter the OTP for each email address into their required field, and click
**Verify accounts** to confirm the codes.

**Final merge confirmation**

This is the final step to confirm the accounts are correct and that you still want to merge. At this point, you're still able to cancel the merge, and nothing will change.

If everything looks good, click **Merge accounts**, and the merge will be completed instantly.

After the merge is complete, an email will be sent to both accounts confirming the merger.

pages.title: Customizing your partner profile
pages.description: Create a strong partner profile to build trust, credibility, and increase partnership opportunities on RevRoute.

headings.text: Where to find your partner profile

pages.body:
Having a strong partner profile is key to getting accepted into partner programs. Follow this guide for help and tips to make your profile stand out.

## Where to find your partner profile

From your main navigation, click the **Partner Profile** icon. Here you can find the fields to add more details about yourself, your interests, and how you earn online.

## Profile Details

Your entire partner profile is viewable by all enrolled programs, and when you submit your application, make sure it looks great and stands out!

### Basic information

The section is for your core details and information that's required to set up your RevRoute account.

#### Profile photo

Upload a clear, professional or on-brand image. Using a profile image or a recognized logo helps build trust.
It's recommended to upload a JPG or PNG that's at least 160px x 160px to fill the profile image.

#### Full name

Input your first and last name so that program owners can easily find you within their program. Some program owners might search for you via your name, so it makes it easier to find your profile quickly in their program.

#### Email

Your email address is used for all partner communications. So when you get paid out or you get accepted into other programs, this email will be used to receive those notifications.

#### Location

This helps if programs are geo-specific and consider that during the application process, or want to understand your audience reach.

#### Profile Type

During your initial account setup, you would've selected one of the following options:

- Individual
- Company

If you are listed as a company, you'll also need to provide your company name. This information is shown to the program owners.

**Внимание.**

  Once your payouts are connected, you can't change your country or profile type. Reach out to
  support if you still need to make any updates.

  The profile type doesn't replace your tax status: for payouts, you set your status
  (self-employed, sole proprietor or legal entity) in your
  payout settings.

### Website and socials

Add the website and social accounts where you share your links: website, YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn. Each field has a **Verify** button: verification shows programs that the website or account is really yours and helps them see what type of content you post and where their links might be shown.

Click **Save changes** to apply your edits.

## About you and your expertise

Consider this section to be your pitch when program owners are deciding who to accept into their program. A well-written profile, with aligned interests, helps you stand out and get accepted into more programs.

### About you

Craft a strong bio to help you stand out alongside other applicants. Your bio should clearly explain who you are, what you do, and who your audience is. For example: 

> “I’m a creator who has a large audience across YouTube, TikTok, and email newsletters. I focus on product reviews, how-to videos, and educational content. My audience is mostly US-based and interested in finance and tech, with over 2 million monthly views across my channels.” 

This gives program owners a quick sense of your reach and focus area.

You can also share any results that prove your ability to drive impact. You might mention how many signups, clicks, or sales you’ve generated for past brands. You can also highlight which industries you’ve worked with and the types of content that tend to perform best for you. For example: 

> “I’ve driven over 2,500 signups for SaaS products in the past three months. I’ve worked with brands in DTC, health & wellness, and crypto, and I’ve seen the strongest results from short-form UGC, newsletter placements, and search ads.”

**Совет.**

  Make your bio brief and to the point. Consider your reader and respect their
  time.

### Industry interests

Add the industries you care about and post content about. This helps programs ensure your content is aligned with theirs and allows them to discover you as well. You can select up to eight industries.

Click **Edit interests** to add or remove industries.

### Estimated monthly traffic

Provide your best estimate of your actual total monthly traffic, including your websites, newsletters, and social accounts. You can select from:

- 0 - 1,000
- 1,000 - 10,000
- 10,000 - 50,000
- 50,000 - 100,000
- 100,000+

## How you work

Share how you prefer to earn and promote products to help programs understand your style of partnership.

### Preferred earning structure

Choose how you prefer to be rewarded, and select all that apply. Select from:

| Structure             | Example                                          |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Rev-share (% of sale) | Earn 20% of the sale value                       |
| Per sale (CPS)        | Earn $20 for each sale you refer                 |
| Per lead (CPL)        | Earn $5 for every qualified lead you send        |
| Per click (CPC)       | Earn $0.50 for every click on your referral link |
| One-time payment      | Earn $50 one-time for each sale referred         |

### Sales channels

Provide the channel where you intend to share your referral links, and select all that apply. Select from:

- Blogs
- Direct selling
- Social media
- Company referrals
- Coupons
- Newsletters
- Events

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.description: Your quick guide to the most common partner questions.

headings.text: How can I change my country?
How can I change my account type – Business / Individual?
How can I update my affiliate link?
How can I update my name, email, or phone number?
Why is my payout still pending?
Why is my commission still pending?
I referred a user but haven't received a commission, what should I do?
My payout failed — what should I do?
Do you support payouts via PayPal, Payoneer, or crypto?
What payout destinations does RevRoute support?
My payout was completed in RevRoute but the money hasn't arrived. What should I do?
Is tax withheld from my payout?
Can I switch payout methods at any time?

pages.body:
We've compiled the most common partner questions in one place, so you can quickly find answers and get back to growing your earnings.

## Account & Settings

### How can I change my country?

You can change your country under your partner profile settings.

For compliance reasons, you cannot change your country once you've connected payouts on RevRoute. If you still need to change your country, please reach out to support.

### How can I change my account type – Business / Individual?

You can change your account type under your partner profile settings.

For compliance reasons, you cannot change your account type once you've connected payouts on RevRoute. If you still need to change it, please reach out to support.

### How can I update my affiliate link?

You can update your affiliate link under the Links tab of your program.

### How can I update my name, email, or phone number?

You can update your personal details under the **Profile** tab in your partner profile. Payout details — your name, tax ID and phone, or your company details — are set separately, in the **Tax details** block of your payout settings.

## Payouts & Earnings

### Why is my payout still pending?

Your payout is still pending because the program hasn't confirmed it yet. Please reach out directly to your program to learn more about their payout schedule.

Some programs also require a minimum payout amount before your payouts can be processed. Also check the program's status in your payout settings: the payout goes through only when it's **Ready**. All the reasons are listed in How to receive payouts.

### Why is my commission still pending?

Your commission is pending because there is a holding period configured by the program (usually 30 days). After the holding period, the commission will be confirmed and eligible for payout.

### I referred a user but haven't received a commission, what should I do?

If you are certain that you followed the instructions to receive a commission, please wait 48 business hours for the commission to appear. If it is still missing, please reach out to your program and they will investigate.

### My payout failed — what should I do?

A payout is marked Failed when RocketWork or the bank couldn't transfer the money. Most often it's about the payout details:

- self-employed and sole proprietors — check your payout details in the RocketWork X app and the program's status in your payout settings: it must be **Ready**;
- legal entities — check the account details in the **Tax details** block of your payout settings.

Once the details are fixed, contact RevRoute support — the payout will be reconciled with the provider.

### Do you support payouts via PayPal, Payoneer, or crypto?

No. RevRoute pays partners exclusively in RUB: self-employed partners and sole proprietors through RocketWork, legal entities to a settlement account at a Russian bank. International payout methods are not supported.

## Payouts

### What payout destinations does RevRoute support?

It depends on the tax status you set in your payout settings:

- **self-employed** — through RocketWork, wherever you chose in the RocketWork X app: a card, SBP or an account;
- **sole proprietors** — through RocketWork, to the sole proprietor's settlement account;
- **legal entities** — to the company's settlement account through the RevRoute nominal account at T-Bank.

Payouts are sent in RUB. Individuals without a tax status can't be paid. Learn more in How to receive payouts.

### My payout was completed in RevRoute but the money hasn't arrived. What should I do?

1. Check your bank's notifications for the incoming credit.
2. Open your card or account statement for the payout date shown in RevRoute.
3. If the transfer isn't there, contact RevRoute support — we'll ask RocketWork or the bank for the payout status.

### Is tax withheld from my payout?

No. RevRoute doesn't withhold or remit taxes on the partner's behalf: payouts go only to self-employed partners, sole proprietors and legal entities, who pay their own taxes. For self-employed partners, RocketWork issues the NPD receipt for each payout.

The amount you'll receive is shown on the Payouts page. If a platform fee was deducted from your earnings, the payout details show it separately.

### Can I switch payout methods at any time?

Yes:

- **self-employed and sole proprietors** — change the card or account in the RocketWork X app. The next payout will go to the new details;
- **legal entities** — update the account details in the **Tax details** block of your payout settings and save.

If your tax status changes (for example, you've gone from self-employed to sole proprietor), choose the new status in the same place and fill in the fields. The program's status will be **Ready** again once RocketWork or the bank confirms the new details.

pages.title: How to join a partner program and set up payouts
pages.description: Step by step for a RevRoute partner: applying to a program, creating a partner account and waiting for approval; then a payout guide for your status.
pages.body:
The path from a program link to the first payout takes four steps: an application, a partner
account, approval by the program and your tax status. The first three are the same for everyone and
are on this page. The fourth depends on who you are — self-employed, a sole proprietor or a legal
entity — and is linked at the end. Without a tax status, earnings accrue but are not paid.

## Apply to the program

### 1. Apply on the program page

Open the program link (`partners.revroute.ru/<program>`) and click **Apply**. The page lists the
reward terms, payout threshold and holding period; the program's offer is linked from the same page.

### 2. Name

The name the program will see you under: sole proprietors and companies may include the legal form.

### 3. Email

The verification code and program notifications go here. It also becomes your login.

### 4. Country

Start typing the name and pick the country from the list.

### 5. Status

Choose how you will receive payouts: **self-employed**, **sole proprietor** or **organization**.
Individuals without one of these statuses are not admitted.

### 6. Program terms

Answer the program's questions (optional) and tick **I accept the program terms** — the link next to
it opens the offer.

### 7. Continue

Click **Continue**. The application is saved; what's left is the account.

## Create a partner account

### 8. Create account

On step 2 click **Create a RevRoute Partners account**. If you already have one, click **Sign in**
and the application attaches to it.

### 9. Password and code

The email is prefilled from the application. Set a password (at least 8 characters with a digit, an
uppercase and a lowercase letter), click **Create account** and enter the six-digit code from the
email. The code is valid for 10 minutes; if it didn't arrive, click **Resend** and check spam.

Next the dashboard offers to add your website and social accounts — you can skip this and return to
it later in your profile.

## Wait for approval

### 10. Application submitted

In **Programs**, the program card shows **Application submitted** with the date. The program reviews
it; once approved, the card shows your partner link and the program sections appear in the left menu.
While the application is pending you can already set your tax status.

## Next: payouts for your status

For your earnings to be paid, set your tax status in the payout settings. The form and the steps
after it depend on the status — pick your guide:

**Self-employed**

    INN and phone as in "Moy Nalog", platform permissions in "Moy Nalog", bank details in the RocketWork X app. RocketWork issues the NPD receipt.

**Sole proprietor**

    INN and phone as registered in RocketWork, the settlement account in the RocketWork X app, a sole proprietor contract.

**Legal entity**

    Company and bank details, a registry check by the bank, money to the settlement account with nothing to sign.

The common rules — holding period, minimum amount, contract signing and FAQs — are in
How to receive payouts from programs.

pages.title: Communicating with your programs
pages.description: Learn about using the messaging center to stay connected with your programs, view conversations, and send messages.

headings.text: Where can I find my messages?

pages.body:
On RevRoute, you can use the built-in Messaging Center to communicate directly with the programs you're enrolled in.

This is helpful for discussing any questions about your rewards structure, commissions, and partner payouts.

## Where can I find my messages?

In your main navigation, click the **Messages** icon to see your inbox and compose new messages. You can also open the conversation with a specific program from its menu: the **Messages** item next to **Overview** and **Links**.

## Messages overview

The messaging center has three panels:

| Panel        | Content                                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| Inbox        | All your conversations in one place.            |
| Conversation | The full thread with your selected program.     |
| Program      | Key info and performance stats for the program. |

### Inbox panel

Your Inbox lists every conversation with the programs you're enrolled in. Select one to pick up where you left off, or click the **Pencil** button in the top right to compose something new and pick a program from the list.

Each conversation row shows:

- **Program** – program's name and program image
- **Last activity** – time of the most recent message from you or the program
- **Excerpt** – short preview of the latest message

### Conversation panel

In the Conversation panel, you’ll see the full thread with the program, with the date and time above the messages. Type your message in the field at the bottom and click **Send**.

### Program panel

The Program panel shows the program's information, the date you joined, your referral link, performance stats and rewards, plus the program's help and support contacts.

## Messaging programs

You can message any program you are enrolled in as long as they have enabled the Messaging Center. You can also contact any program by email using the support link in the Program panel and at the bottom of the program menu.

pages.title: Navigating a partner program
pages.description: Learn how to navigate your programs, measure your performance, manage your referral links, and view your earnings.

headings.text: How to view your joined programs
Aggregated data for different facets (top views)

pages.body:
## How to view your joined programs

From the **All** **programs** navigation, click **Programs** to view all the partner programs you've joined. If you haven't joined any programs, you'll see an empty state here.

There are two ways to view all the pages related to a specific program:

**Program grid**

    On the **Programs** page, we show you a grid of all the programs you've
    joined. We also show you your default referral link and your total earnings.
    Click on the card to view that program page.

**All programs dropdown**

    The other way you can navigate to your programs is to click **All programs**
    at the top of the sidebar, and that will open a dropdown. From here, you can
    search and click on any of the programs listed. You can also click on **All
    programs** in this dropdown, and that will take you back to the grid view
    anytime.

## Program pages

### Overview

This is your main program overview page, is the first page you'll want to check to see how your programs are performing.

The page has the following sections:

- **Program summary** - find your default referral link and the rewards and discounts you are eligible for on this program. If you want to hide this section, click the **Hide details** button in the top right, and it won't show until you click the button again.
- **Program earnings and payouts** - see how much you've earned over time, and your most recent payouts. The earnings section also allows you to change the date range to view results from further in the past.
- **Link analytics** - View your clicks, leads and sales for this program, keep track of all their activity.
- **Recent earnings** - A detailed breakdown of your most recent earnings and their payout status.

### Links

You'll find all your program referral links on this page, including the clicks, leads, and sales for each.

Clicking on the link card opens a dialog window that will allow you to edit the
short link, destination URL, QR code, and add comments. If you change an
existing short link, be sure to update it wherever it's being shared; otherwise,
the previous short link will stop tracking, and you won't be able to earn any
new rewards for that link.

From this page, you're also able to create new short links by clicking **Create
link** in the top right of this page.

### Resources

Quite often, programs will provide additional assets and resources to help their partners when sharing their referral links.

The resources are split into four sections:

1. **Brand logos** - These are the official logo and brand files from the program.
2. **Links** - Useful pages the program shares with its partners.
3. **Colors** - Make sure you're using the correct hex values in your campaigns or other marketing assets.
4. **Additional files** - This is for anything else that may fall outside of the brand logos and colors. It could be additional marketing images, documents to read, or campaign examples. If anything is missing that you'll need to be successful, make sure to contact the program's support at the bottom of the program navigation.

### Earnings

View your earnings performance over time and the details associated with each item.

In the top section, you can change the view type by **Link** or **Type**, to be
able to see which links are performing better, or which reward type has earned
more (pending the program offers rewards for clicks, leads, and sales).

### Analytics

View your program performance analytics, and filter and organize by clicks, leads, and sales.

#### Data toggle

You can change the data displayed by clicking the `123 | $` toggle in the top right of the data type section.

By default `$` is selected, as it is related directly to your reward earnings. Switching to `123` will change any monetary values to their specific reward count. If the program you're on has other monetary rewards (clicks, leads, sales), their dollar amount will show as well.

#### Chart toggle

You can change the chart type displayed by clicking the `time-chart | conversion funnel` toggle in the top right of the chart area.

When the chart type is switched to **conversion funnel**, you can view the percentage of customers that complete each stage of the sales conversion. In this example, 0.58% of clicks have resulted in a referral making a purchase.

#### Aggregated data for different facets (top views)

These are more commonly known as the "Top Views" in RevRoute Analytics. These views show your top links, countries, cities, devices, and more.

Each section has their own tabs to select different data for you to explore your program data further. These are grouped by the following categories:

- **Links** - Short Links and Destination URLs
- **Referrals** - Referrers and UTM Parameters
- **Location** - Countries, Cities, Regions, and Continents
- **Tech** - Devices, Browser, OS, and Triggers

### Events

View your program events, and filter and organize by clicks, leads, and sales. RevRoute's real-time events stream is a detailed, real-time stream of events across each program you've joined.

You can filter this data, select a different date range, and change the data
shown by clicking on Clicks, Leads, and Sales in the top section.

## Program help and support

Every program provides email support for its partners and the questions you have that are specific to the program. Optionally, a program may also provide a link to the help documentation and up-to-date terms of service.

The section is always located at the bottom of the program page navigation to
make it easy to find, so you know where to access support at the right moment.

For RevRoute platform support, reporting bugs, or other partner-related issues, reach out to us anytime.

pages.title: How commissions and payouts work on RevRoute
pages.description: Learn about the different commission and payout statuses on RevRoute and when you can expect to be paid by the programs you work with.
pages.body:
As an affiliate partner on RevRoute, you can participate in various affiliate programs and receive commission payouts: self-employed partners and sole proprietors through RocketWork, legal entities to their settlement account.

In this article, we'll explore how commissions and payouts work on RevRoute, their various statuses, and when you can expect to be paid by the programs you work with.

## Commission statuses

When you receive a commission on RevRoute, it goes through the following statuses:

- `Pending`: This is the initial status for a commission. Depending on your program's holding period, commissions can stay in "pending" status anywhere from less than a day to 90 days.
- `Processed`: When a commission has been added to a payout (after any applicable holding period), its status will change from "pending" to "processed".
- `Paid`: When the payout containing the commission has been paid by the program, the commission will be updated to "paid" status.

Occasionally, commissions can also be updated to the following statuses:

- `Refunded`: If the sale for the commission was refunded. This is detected automatically when the program tracks a refund through their billing webhook, or set manually by the program.
- `Fraud`: If a sale was marked as fraudulent by your program.
- `Canceled`: If a sale was marked as canceled/voided by your program (e.g. in cases of self-referrals where commissions are not eligible for payout).
- `Duplicate`: If a sale was marked as duplicate by your program.

In these cases, we recommend reaching out to your program's support email with any questions/appeals that you might have.

## Payout statuses

Payouts on RevRoute go through the following statuses:

- `Pending`: When you start earning commissions from a program, they'll be accrued under a payout entry. If the program has a minimum payout amount set, your payout amount will need to reach the threshold to become eligible for payment. The payout goes through only when the program's status in your payout settings is **Ready**.
- `Processing`: The program has confirmed the payout. Self-employed partners and sole proprietors get an email asking them to sign a one-off contract in RocketWork: the money is sent only after signing. Legal entities don't need to do anything.
- `Sent`: RocketWork or the bank is transferring the money.
- `Completed`: The money has arrived. For self-employed partners, RocketWork issues the NPD receipt to the client company automatically.
- `Failed`: RocketWork or the bank couldn't transfer the money. Check your payout details (what to do) and contact RevRoute support.

All payouts across all programs are on the **Payouts** page of your partner dashboard: a summary at the top (**Pending**, **Processing** and **Completed**), and below it a table with the period, program, status, dates and amount.

If you haven't set your tax status yet, do it in your payout settings.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does "holding period" mean?

Programs can set certain **holding periods** for earned commissions, during which your commissions will be kept in `pending` status and won't be eligible for payout:

- 0 days
- 14 days
- 30 days (most common)
- 60 days
- 90 days

This is usually done for security / fraud prevention purposes, as well as to account for potential refunds/chargebacks from referred customers.

### What does "minimum payout amount" mean?

Programs can also set a **minimum payout amount** (e.g. 1 000 ₽), where commissions will be accrued and only eligible for payout after it surpasses the minimum threshold.

The default payout amount on RevRoute is 0 ₽.

### When will I get paid?

This depends on your program's payment schedule, which is usually at the beginning or the end of the month. We recommend reaching out to your program's support team to confirm the exact payment date.

pages.title: Legal entity payouts: company details and settlement account
pages.description: What a company fills in on RevRoute to get paid to its settlement account: Legal entity status, INN, OGRN, address, bank details, the bank's registry check.

headings.text: 3. Name, INN, OGRN, KPP and address
4. Registration date, phone and bank details

pages.body:
Programs pay companies to their settlement account through RevRoute's nominal account at T-Bank. No
contracts or receipts to sign per payout: you fill in the company and bank details once, and the bank
checks the company against the EGRUL registry.

By now you have applied to the program and created a partner account — if not, start with
How to join a partner program.

## Set your tax status

### 1. Set status

Open **Payouts** in the left menu. Until the status is set, a warning **Set your tax status** stays at
the top of the page — click **Set status**. The same form opens from **Payout settings** at the top
right.

### 2. Status: legal entity

In **Tax details** choose **Legal entity** — the form switches to company details.

### 3. Name, INN, OGRN, KPP and address

Company name — as in EGRUL. INN — 10 digits, OGRN — 13. KPP is optional: leave it empty if you don't
have one. Legal address — from the EGRUL extract: the bank checks the company against these details.

### 4. Registration date, phone and bank details

Registration date — from EGRUL. Phone is optional but useful if the bank has questions about the
company. In **Bank details**: BIC and bank name, settlement and correspondent account — the money
arrives to this account.

### 5. Save

Click **Save**. The badge changes to **Profile complete** and the warning on the payouts page changes
to "Payout setup not finished" until the bank's check completes.

## Bank check

After saving, RevRoute passes the details to the bank for every program that pays legal entities. In
the **Settlement account payouts** block each program gets a status:

| Status | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Checking** | Nothing: the bank is verifying the company against EGRUL. The status refreshes every 10 minutes. |
| **Rejected by the bank** | The bank didn't confirm the company in EGRUL — compare INN, OGRN and name with the extract and save again. |
| **Setup not finished** | Nothing: the program is still setting up payouts to legal entities. |
| **Ready** | Everything is set up, the payout goes through automatically. |

The details are shared across programs: pass the check once and you get **Ready** everywhere a program
pays legal entities.

### 6. Status: Ready

Once the bank confirms the company, the program shows **Ready** and the warning on the payouts page
disappears. From then on payouts from this program arrive to the settlement account without any action
from you.

## Money and documents

The program starts the payout once commissions pass the holding period and reach the minimum amount.
If the amount is below the minimum, the payouts page shows "min." and the program's threshold next to
it — the payout accumulates until the next period. Nothing to sign: after the program confirms the
payout, the money goes to the company's settlement account; the amount sent to the bank is in whole
rubles.

### 7. Payout status

On the **Payouts** page a payout is **Pending** until the program confirms it. After confirmation it is
**Sent**: the bank is processing the transfer, the **Paid** column says "processing" and the amount is
counted in the **Processing** card. When the money arrives, the status changes to **Completed** and the
**Paid** column shows the date.

Each payout's status is on the Payouts page; why a payout may be
delayed — in the FAQs.

pages.title: Self-employed payouts: tax status, Moy Nalog and RocketWork
pages.description: What a self-employed partner fills in on RevRoute to get paid: status, INN and phone as in Moy Nalog, platform permissions, bank details in RocketWork X, the NPD receipt.

headings.text: Permissions in Moy Nalog and bank details

pages.body:
Programs pay self-employed partners through RocketWork: a one-off contract is issued for every payout,
the NPD receipt is generated automatically and the money arrives by card, SBP or to an account. You set
your status, INN and phone once in the partner dashboard, grant the platform permissions in the "Moy
Nalog" app and add bank details in the RocketWork X app.

By now you have applied to the program and created a partner account — if not, start with
How to join a partner program.

## Set your tax status

### 1. Set status

Open **Payouts** in the left menu. Until the status is set, a warning **Set your tax status** stays at
the top of the page — click **Set status**. The same form opens from **Payout settings** at the top
right.

### 2. Status: self-employed

In **Tax details** choose **Self-employed**. If you are not registered as an NPD payer yet, do it first
in the "Moy Nalog" app — it takes a few minutes.

### 3. INN, name and phone

INN — 12 digits, the same as in "Moy Nalog". Last name, first name and patronymic (if any) — as in
your passport. Phone — the one you are registered with in RocketWork (or will register with: the
invitation goes there). If the data doesn't match, the status will be **Check your details**.

### 4. Save

Click **Save** in this block. The badge changes to **Profile complete** and the warning on the payouts
page changes to "Payout setup not finished" until the check completes.

## Permissions in Moy Nalog and bank details

### 5. SMS from RocketWork

After saving, RevRoute registers you as a contractor in RocketWork with the program, and the phone
you entered receives an SMS from the sender `rocketwork`: the company whose program you promote
invites you to RocketWork. Follow the link in the SMS and sign up in the **RocketWork X** app with
the same phone number. No SMS — the payout settings show a **Resend invitation** button next to
the program (at most once every 10 minutes).

In the **RocketWork payouts** block each program gets a status:

| Status | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Checking** | Nothing, usually a few minutes. |
| **Permissions needed** | Click **Request permissions in Moy Nalog** and confirm the request in the "Moy Nalog" app (Partners section): without it RocketWork can't issue receipts on your behalf. |
| **Not self-employed** | The tax service doesn't see you as an NPD payer: register in "Moy Nalog" and come back to the settings. |
| **No bank details** | Sign up in the RocketWork X app via the link from the SMS (step 5) and choose there where to receive money: SBP, card or account. |
| **Check your details** | Compare the INN and phone with those in "Moy Nalog" and RocketWork. |
| **Tax debt** | Pay the tax in "Moy Nalog" — payouts are closed until then. |
| **Payouts closed** | Contact RocketWork support — they know the reason. |
| **Ready** | Everything is set up, the payout goes through automatically. |

Permissions in "Moy Nalog", the RocketWork account and bank details are shared across programs: set
them up once and you get **Ready** everywhere a program pays through RocketWork.

## Contract, receipt and money

The program starts the payout once commissions pass the holding period and reach the minimum amount.
When the program confirms the payout, you get an email asking you to sign the contract, and the
**Waiting for your signature** section appears in payout settings.

### 6. Sign

Open **Payout settings** on the Payouts page and click **Sign**
next to the program in **Waiting for your signature** — the contract opens in RocketWork. The same link is in
the email, and the signing request is in the RocketWork X app.

### 7. SMS code

On the contract page click **Sign contract** and enter the six-digit code from the SMS sent to your
phone. If it didn't arrive or didn't work, click **send again** (after 30 seconds). Once the code is
accepted, your signature appears under "Who signed".

### 8. Payout status

After signing RocketWork transfers the money. On the **Payouts** page the payout becomes **Sent** with
the amount you receive, then **Completed** once the transfer is done.

After payment RocketWork issues the NPD receipt to the client company itself — you don't need to issue
it in "Moy Nalog".

Why a payout may be delayed — in the FAQs.

pages.title: Sole proprietor payouts: tax status and RocketWork
pages.description: What a sole proprietor fills in on RevRoute to get paid through RocketWork: status, INN, phone, settlement account, contract.
pages.body:

INN — 12 digits, as in the EGRIP registry. Last name, first name and patronymic (if any) — as in your

### 4. Save

## Confirm in RocketWork

### 5. SMS from RocketWork

After saving, RevRoute registers you as a contractor in RocketWork with the program, and the phone
you entered receives an SMS from the sender `rocketwork`: the company whose program you promote
invites you to RocketWork. Follow the link in the SMS and sign up in the **RocketWork X** app with

In the **RocketWork payouts** block each program gets a status:

| Status | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Checking** | Nothing, usually a few minutes. |
| **No bank details** | Sign up in the RocketWork X app via the link from the SMS (step 5) and add the **settlement account** of your sole proprietorship there. Cards and SBP are not available to sole proprietors. |
| **Check your details** | Compare the INN and phone with those in RocketWork. |
| **Payouts closed** | Contact RocketWork support — they know the reason. |
| **Ready** | Everything is set up, the payout goes through automatically. |

Your RocketWork account and bank details are shared across programs: set them up once and you get
**Ready** everywhere a program pays through RocketWork.

## Contract and money

The program starts the payout once commissions pass the holding period and reach the minimum amount.
When the program confirms the payout, you get an email asking you to sign the contract, and the
**Waiting for your signature** section appears in payout settings.

### 6. Sign

Open **Payout settings** on the Payouts page and click **Sign**
next to the program in **Waiting for your signature** — the contract opens in RocketWork. The same link is in
the email, and the signing request is in the RocketWork X app.

### 7. SMS code

On the contract page click **Sign contract** and enter the six-digit code from the SMS sent to your
phone. If it didn't arrive or didn't work, click **send again** (after 30 seconds). Once the code is

### 8. Payout status

The money arrives to the sole proprietor's settlement account. No NPD receipt is needed: the signed

Why a payout may be delayed — in the FAQs.

pages.title: How to receive payouts from programs
pages.description: What a partner needs to set up to receive payouts on RevRoute: tax details, RocketWork for self-employed and sole proprietors, a settlement account for legal entities, signing the contract.

headings.text: 2. Self-employed and sole proprietors: RocketWork status
3. Legal entities: payouts to a settlement account
4. Signing the contract and getting paid
Why is my payout still pending?
Can I receive payouts as an individual without a tax status?
Do I need to withdraw my earnings manually?

pages.body:
On RevRoute, payouts go to **self-employed individuals, sole proprietors and legal entities** — with a
receipt or closing documents issued to the company whose program you promote. An individual without
one of these statuses can't be paid.

To get your money:

1. Fill in your tax details in the payout settings.
2. Get the payout status for each program to "Ready".
3. When a program sends a payout, sign the contract via the link (self-employed and sole proprietors).

You don't need to withdraw anything manually: the program starts the payout once your commissions
clear the holding period and reach the minimum payout amount.

## Where to set up payouts

Open partners.revroute.ru/payouts and click
**Payout settings** in the top right. The panel has three blocks:

- **Tax details** — your status and details;
- **Payouts via RocketWork** (or **Payouts to a settlement account** for legal entities) — readiness
  for each program you're in;
- **Invoice details (optional)** — what to print on payout invoices, see
  Customizing invoice details.

## 1. Fill in your tax details

In the **Tax details** block, choose your **Status** and fill in the fields:

| Status | What to enter |
|---|---|
| **Self-employed** | Tax ID (INN, 12 digits), last name, first name, middle name (if any), phone |
| **Sole proprietor** | Tax ID (INN, 12 digits), last name, first name, middle name (if any), phone |
| **Legal entity** | Company name, Tax ID (INN, 10 digits), OGRN, KPP (if any), legal address, registration date, bank details: BIC, bank name, settlement and correspondent accounts |

Click **Save** in this block. A **Profile complete** badge appears next to the heading.

**Внимание.**

  Self-employed and sole proprietors: the phone must be the one your RocketWork account is registered
  to, and the INN must match the one in the "My Tax" (Мой налог) app. If they don't match,
  RocketWork rejects the details (status "Check your details").

## 2. Self-employed and sole proprietors: RocketWork status

Programs pay self-employed partners and sole proprietors through
RocketWork: each payout comes with a one-off contract, and the
self-employed tax receipt is generated automatically. Once you save your tax details, RevRoute
registers you as a contractor with each program.

The **Payouts via RocketWork** block shows a status for each program. A payout goes through only
when it's **Ready**. What to do otherwise:

| Status | What to do |
|---|---|
| **Tax details needed** | Fill in your tax details above. |
| **Checking** | Nothing — the check usually takes a few minutes. |
| **Permissions needed** | Click **Request permissions in My Tax** and approve the request in the "My Tax" app. |
| **Not self-employed** | The tax service doesn't see you as self-employed: register in "My Tax" and come back. |
| **No bank details** | Add a card or account for payouts in the RocketWork X app. Self-employed can use SBP, a card or an account; sole proprietors — a settlement account only. |
| **Check your details** | Make sure your INN and phone match "My Tax" and RocketWork. |
| **Tax unpaid** | Pay the outstanding tax in "My Tax" — payouts are blocked until then. |
| **Payouts blocked** | Contact RocketWork support — they know the reason. |
| **Not connected** | Nothing: this program doesn't pay via RocketWork yet. |
| **Setup incomplete** | Nothing: the program is still setting up payouts. |

Your RocketWork account, "My Tax" permissions and bank details are shared across all programs: set
them up once and you'll be **Ready** everywhere a program pays via RocketWork.

## 3. Legal entities: payouts to a settlement account

Legal entities are paid to the company's settlement account through RevRoute's nominal account at
T-Bank. Instead of the RocketWork block, the settings show **Payouts to a settlement account** with a
status for each program. The bank checks the company against the state register: if the status is
**Bank rejected**, double-check the INN and OGRN in your tax details.

## 4. Signing the contract and getting paid

Self-employed and sole proprietors: once the program approves a payout, a **Waiting for your
signature** section appears in the payout settings with the program and amount. Click **Sign** — it
opens RocketWork, where you sign with a code from an SMS. The money is sent only after you sign.

Legal entities don't need to sign anything: the money goes to the settlement account once the
payout is approved.

You can track payout status on the Payouts page.

## FAQs

### Why is my payout still pending?

There can be several reasons, all of them visible:

- the commission is still in the **holding period** set by the program (e.g. 30 days in case of a refund);
- you haven't reached the program's **minimum payout amount**;
- your status for this program in **Payout settings** isn't **Ready**;
- the program hasn't approved the payout yet.

Ask the program about its holding period and minimum payout amount.

### Can I receive payouts as an individual without a tax status?

No. Only self-employed individuals, sole proprietors and legal entities can be paid. You can become
self-employed in a few minutes in the "My Tax" app.

### What currency are payouts in?

Rubles only, to Russian cards and accounts.

### Do I need to withdraw my earnings manually?

No. The program starts the payout. All you need is a **Ready** status and to sign the contract when it
arrives.

pages.description: One entry point to every RevRoute resource: developer documentation for links, attribution and webhooks, plus the help center for day-to-day dashboard work.
pages.body:
Everything RevRoute publishes lives here. The two sections differ by audience:
the documentation is written for developers, the help center for whoever works
in the dashboard.

**Developer docs**

    Links, attribution, conversions, webhooks and tracking scripts

**Help center**

    Dashboard work: programs, partners, links, domains, payouts

**Legal**

    Offers, tariffs, terms of service and privacy policy

## Starting from scratch

If you are connecting RevRoute for the first time, follow the route in
Getting started: domain → tracking script → `lead` and
`sale` events → webhooks.

If you are launching a partner program and don't write code,
setting up your program
in the help center is the place to begin.

## Common developer questions

- How attribution works — from click to sale
- Server-side conversion tracking — the recommended path
- Webhooks overview — which events fire and how to verify signatures
- OAuth apps — tokens and scopes for third-party integrations
- Troubleshooting — what to do when events don't arrive
